units.name: Introduction
units.assessment: Can you list the genotypes that make up sickle cell disease, and trace the path from HbS polymerization through hemolysis, adhesion and inflammation to vaso-occlusion and cumulative organ damage?

lesson.title: Haematology series: Sickle cell disease
lesson.why: A full clinician-directed teaching session on sickle cell disease that sets out genotypes, pathophysiology and the shape of the disease before the organ-specific sections.

drills.name: Biochemistry of HbS
drills.title: Biochemistry of Sickle Cell Anemia & HbS

drills.name: Sickle cell trait and exertion
drills.title: Sickle Cell Trait- Exertional Sickling in Athletes

units.name: Laboratory features
units.assessment: Can you interpret a hemoglobin quantitation showing HbS with HbA, and separate sickle cell trait from HbS/beta-plus thalassemia and from HbSS using the indices, the film and the percentages?

lesson.title: Lab Aspects of Haemoglobinopathies (Sickle Cell) inc. difficult cases and challenges of diagnosis
lesson.why: A laboratory-diagnosis session built around difficult cases and pitfalls in identifying sickle haemoglobin, which is precisely what this laboratory-features section covers.

drills.name: Sickled cells on the smear
drills.title: Sickle Cell Anemia under the Microscope: Peripheral Blood Smear

units.name: Clinical manifestations
units.assessment: Can you recognise the sickle cell emergencies - acute chest syndrome, splenic sequestration, parvovirus aplastic crisis, stroke, priapism - and say what separates each from an uncomplicated painful episode?

lesson.title: Sickle Cell Crisis Explained | VOC, Acute Chest Syndrome & Emergencies Made Simple
lesson.channel: Whiteboard Medicine Emergency And Critical Care
lesson.why: Organises the acute presentations of sickle cell disease the way they actually arrive, which is the framework this clinical-manifestations section is teaching.

drills.name: Presentation patterns
drills.title: Clinical Presentations Associated With Sickle Cell Disease

drills.name: Chronic complication burden
drills.title: Considering Complications of Sickle Cell Disease

units.name: Painful episodes
units.assessment: Can you describe your analgesic plan for an acute vaso-occlusive episode, including how fast the first parenteral dose should be given, and how you would adjust it for a patient already on chronic opioids?

lesson.title: Sickle Cell Disease: Vaso Occlusive Episodes in the Emergency Department
lesson.why: A full session on managing vaso-occlusive episodes in the acute setting, including time-to-analgesia targets and the reasons sickle cell pain is systematically undertreated.

drills.name: Chronic pain phenotype
drills.title: Chronic Pain and Sickle Cell Disease with Dr. Jeffery Weisman

units.name: Central nervous system disease
units.assessment: Can you state at what ages and with which test children with sickle cell anemia are screened for stroke risk, what velocity triggers chronic transfusion, and what a silent cerebral infarct predicts?

lesson.title: Webinar #7: Sickle Cell Disease and the Brain - Kaitlyn Strumph, DO
lesson.why: A dedicated grand-rounds style talk on cerebrovascular and cognitive disease in sickle cell disease, covering TCD screening, overt stroke and silent infarcts.

drills.name: Neurodevelopmental effects
drills.title: Dr Eboni Lance, MD- Neurodevelopmental effects of Sickle cell disease

drills.name: Neurology of blood disease
drills.title: Subspecialty Lecture: Neurological Manifestations of Hematological Diseases with Dr. Dana Shani

drills.name: Neurocognition after transplant
drills.title: Significantly improving HRQL and neurocognition in high-risk sickle cell following familial ASCT
drills.channel: VJHemOnc – Video Journal of Hematology & HemOnc

units.name: Pulmonary disease
units.assessment: Can you define acute chest syndrome, name its usual precipitants, and say at what point you would escalate from simple transfusion to red cell exchange in a hypoxic patient?

lesson.title: 1/22/21 Pulmonary Complications of Sickle Cell Disease- Dr. Shakaroun
lesson.why: A fellow-level lecture devoted to the pulmonary complications of sickle cell disease, from acute chest syndrome through chronic lung disease and pulmonary hypertension.

drills.name: Emerging pulmonary treatments
drills.title: Pulmonary Complications and Emerging Treatments of Sickle Cell Disease

units.name: Cardiac disease
units.assessment: Can you explain why an elevated tricuspid regurgitant jet velocity matters in sickle cell disease, and how you would separate anemia-driven high-output physiology from true pulmonary hypertension or a restrictive cardiomyopathy?

lesson.title: Sickle Cell: Cardiac issues and management
lesson.why: A haemoglobinopathy centre session devoted to the cardiac phenotype of sickle cell disease - the high-output state that anemia alone produces, diastolic dysfunction, the significance of a raised tricuspid regurgitant jet velocity, and how these are told apart and managed.

drills.name: Emerging cardiac evidence
drills.title: Cardiac Complications in Sickle Cell Disease: Emerging Evidence and Risks

drills.name: Distinct heart failure mechanisms
drills.title: Characterizing distinct mechanisms of heart failure in patients with sickle cell disease
drills.channel: VJHemOnc – Video Journal of Hematology & HemOnc

units.name: Reproductive health and pregnancy
units.assessment: Can you counsel a woman with sickle cell disease about contraception, the maternal and fetal risks pregnancy adds, and whether hydroxyurea should be stopped before conception and when it can be restarted?

lesson.title: Sickle Cell Disease in Pregnancy
lesson.why: A society-level teaching talk focused specifically on managing sickle cell disease through pregnancy, including transfusion decisions and obstetric risk.

drills.name: Care across the continuum
drills.title: Sickle Cell Care in Pregnancy and Beyond: Optimizing Reproductive Health Across the Care Continuum

drills.name: Fertility and reproductive health
drills.title: #47 - “Reproductive Health in Sickle Cell” with Dr. Lydia Pecker

drills.name: Prenatal testing options
drills.title: Reproductive Options and Prenatal Testing for Women with Sickle Cell Disease
drills.channel: Foundation for Women & Girls With Blood Disorders

units.name: Treatment
units.assessment: Can you say who should be offered hydroxyurea and how it is dose-escalated, and place crizanlizumab, L-glutamine, transplant and the two approved gene therapies in a current treatment sequence?

lesson.title: Emerging Pharmacotherapeutic Approaches for the Management of Sickle Cell Disease
lesson.why: A long-form review of the current and emerging drug therapies for sickle cell disease, which is the breadth this six-page treatment section demands.

drills.title: 4/11/2025 - How Gene Therapy Saves Sickle Cell Disease (Hint - It Is Not What You Think)
